answer: A new key can vote only after it has lived past a 6-epoch horizon with no reward, then won one of 80 scarce lagoon slots by posting a 1,200-unit slashable basalt bond that is seized if funding graphs, keys, or puzzle clocks collide. Each extra identity must buy its own unpaid wait, its own slot, and its own bond; a farm of 500 names therefore locks 600,000 units, burns 500 waiting periods, and loses every linked bond on one collision, so a cheap majority cannot break even.
